_comment: Final 256 px cell coordinates on the packed quantize-48 frames. Only beamStruggle so far; Goku's other beams fall back to the engine's fixed offsets (TASKS follow-up).

bair._note: ENG-112 bair v01: packed-cell contact override (Claude integration check 2026-10-18); f2/f3 kick screen-left behind Goku, so the boxes follow the extended rear foot and shin instead of the default front box over his body. Measured on the packed cells at packScale 0.92.

uTilt._note: ENG-112 Goku uTilt v04, measured on the relay #45 48-color packed atlas at fighter packScale 0.92 × strip packScale 1.09. f3 fist/wrist box and f4 raised fist/wrist box from Astra final5 visual inspection; version-bound so later drawings do not inherit them.
